import HartshorneLib.Chapter4ProjectivePullbackPointCoordinates

/-!
# Polynomial fractions in pulled projective coordinates

Surjectivity of the stalk map of an arbitrary projective morphism expresses
each source germ as a fraction of polynomials in its pulled chart coordinates.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Opposite TopologicalSpace AlgebraicGeometry

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

/-- On an affine target neighbourhood, a surjective stalk map expresses every
source germ as a fraction of pulled regular functions. -/
theorem exists_stalk_fraction_of_affine_target
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (V : Y.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (x : X) (hx : f x ∈ V) (hsurj : Function.Surjective (f.stalkMap x).hom)
    (z : X.presheaf.stalk x) :
    let g := (X.presheaf.germ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) x hx).hom
    let h := (f.appLE V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl).hom
    ∃ a b : Γ(Y, V), IsUnit (g (h b)) ∧ z * g (h b) = g (h a) := by
  letI : Algebra Γ(Y, V) (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) :=
    Y.presheaf.algebra_section_stalk ⟨f x, hx⟩
  letI : IsLocalization.AtPrime (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x))
      (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨f x, hx⟩).asIdeal := hV.isLocalization_stalk ⟨f x, hx⟩
  have hcomm (a : Γ(Y, V)) :
      (f.stalkMap x).hom (algebraMap Γ(Y, V) (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) a) =
        (X.presheaf.germ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) x hx).hom
          ((f.appLE V (f ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl).hom a) := by
    change (f.stalkMap x).hom ((Y.presheaf.germ V (f x) hx).hom a) = _
    rw [Scheme.Hom.germ_stalkMap_apply]
    simp [Scheme.Hom.appLE]
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := hsurj z
  obtain ⟨⟨a, b⟩, hab⟩ :=
    IsLocalization.surj (hV.primeIdealOf ⟨f x, hx⟩).asIdeal.primeCompl t
  refine ⟨a, b, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hu := (IsLocalization.map_units (Y.presheaf.stalk (f x)) b).map
      (f.stalkMap x).hom
    simpa only [hcomm] using hu
  · have heq := congrArg (f.stalkMap x).hom hab
    simpa only [map_mul, ht, hcomm] using heq

namespace ProjectivePullback

attribute [local instance] MvPolynomial.gradedAlgebra

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {n : ℕ}
  {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}

/-- A surjective stalk map of an arbitrary projective morphism expresses every
source germ as a fraction of polynomial evaluations in its pulled normalized
chart coordinates, with unit denominator. -/
theorem exists_polynomial_stalk_fraction_of_surjective
    (f : X.left ⟶ projectiveSpace k n)
    (hf : f ≫ projectiveSpaceStructureMap k n = X.hom)
    (x : X.left) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (hi : f x ∈ ProjectiveTwist.chart (k := k) i)
    (hsurj : Function.Surjective (f.stalkMap x).hom)
    (z : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) :
    let U := f ⁻¹ᵁ ProjectiveTwist.chart i
    let g := (X.left.presheaf.germ U x hi).hom
    let ψ := MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (g.comp (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U))
      (fun j => g ((f.appLE (ProjectiveTwist.chart i) U le_rfl).hom
        (ProjectiveTwist.coordinate i j)))
    ∃ P Q : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k,
      IsUnit (ψ Q) ∧ z * ψ Q = ψ P := by
  let V := ProjectiveTwist.chart (k := k) i
  let U := f ⁻¹ᵁ V
  let g := (X.left.presheaf.germ U x hi).hom
  let h := (f.appLE V U le_rfl).hom
  let A := HomogeneousLocalization.Away
    (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k) (MvPolynomial.X i)
  let e : A →+* X.left.presheaf.stalk x := g.comp (h.comp
    (Proj.awayToSection (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k)
      (MvPolynomial.X i)).hom)
  let ψ := MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (g.comp (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U))
    (fun j => g (h (ProjectiveTwist.coordinate i j)))
  have heval : e.comp (ProjectiveCoordinates.eval
      (ProjectiveCoordinates.chartCoord (k := k) i)) = ψ := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro c
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, ProjectiveCoordinates.eval,
        MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C, ψ]
      change g (h ((Proj.awayToSection
        (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k)
        (MvPolynomial.X i)).hom (algebraMap k A c))) =
          g (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U c)
      exact congrArg g (ProjectiveTwist.appLE_awayScalar f hf i U le_rfl c)
    · intro j
      simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, ProjectiveCoordinates.eval_X, ψ,
        MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_X']
      rfl
  have hrepresent (a : Γ(projectiveSpace k n, V)) :
      ∃ P : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k, g (h a) = ψ P := by
    let hs : Function.Surjective (Proj.awayToSection
        (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k) (MvPolynomial.X i)).hom := by
      intro a
      obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := (Proj.basicOpenIsoAway
        (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k) (MvPolynomial.X i)
        (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) one_pos).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv.surjective a
      exact ⟨w, hw⟩
    obtain ⟨w, hw⟩ := hs a
    rw [← hw]
    obtain ⟨m, P, hP, rfl⟩ := HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk_surjective
      (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k)
      (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) w
    refine ⟨P, ?_⟩
    have hevalP := DFunLike.congr_fun heval P
    change e (ProjectiveCoordinates.eval (ProjectiveCoordinates.chartCoord i) P) = ψ P
      at hevalP
    rw [eval_chartCoord_homogeneous i P (m := m) (by simpa using hP)] at hevalP
    change g (h ((Proj.awayToSection
      (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k) (MvPolynomial.X i)).hom
        (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk
          (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k)
          (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) m P hP))) = ψ P
    convert hevalP using 1;
      simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.Away.isLocalizationElem, pow_one,
        e, RingHom.comp_apply];
      congr
  have hV : IsAffineOpen V := Proj.isAffineOpen_basicOpen
    (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k) (MvPolynomial.X i)
    (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) one_pos
  obtain ⟨a, b, hb, hab⟩ := exists_stalk_fraction_of_affine_target f V hV x hi hsurj z
  obtain ⟨P, hP⟩ := hrepresent a
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := hrepresent b
  refine ⟨P, Q, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact hQ ▸ hb
  · change z * ψ Q = ψ P
    rw [← hQ, ← hP]
    exact hab

end ProjectivePullback

end
end Hartshorne
